hint_ladder: Say that a group reached a judgement after thinking about the facts.
Use come to or reach before a conclusion; do not use make.
Start with the words: The team came to a ___ after the meeting.
teaching_content.reveal_form: The team came to a conclusion after the meeting.
canonical_forms: The team came to a conclusion after the meeting.
alternative_realizations: The team reached a conclusion after the meeting.
